design_detail: Annual progressive wealth tax with PLN 10m exemption and marginal rates from 1% to 8%
quote_en: We propose a progressive wealth-tax schedule:
source_title: Jak multimilionerzy mogą pomóc w ratowaniu klimatu?
grading_note: Party statement explicitly sets out wealth thresholds and rates; not income or property taxation alone.

design_detail: Wealth-tax-linked exit levy of 40%; 60% above PLN 1bn
quote_original: Ponadto wprowadzimy tzw. exit tax w wysokości 40% majątku
quote_en: We will also introduce an exit tax of 40% of wealth
source_title: Jak multimilionerzy mogą pomóc w ratowaniu klimatu?
grading_note: Explicit anti-avoidance exit levy attached to the party's wealth-tax design.

design_detail: EU tax on large fortunes; declaration adopted at the 8-9 November 2025 congress
quote_original: a także unijnego podatku od wielkich majątków.
quote_en: and also an EU tax on large fortunes.
grading_note: Explicit support for a named EU wealth tax; no rate or threshold here. Adoption date appears on the declaration's parent page. Grade A under the formal-act clause: adopted organisational policy or authored publication recommending a wealth tax.

design_detail: Future net-wealth tax on fortunes of hundreds of millions or billions of PLN
quote_original: W przyszłości również należałoby pomyśleć nad wprowadzeniem podatku od majątków netto
quote_en: In the future we should also consider introducing a tax on net wealth
source_title: Podatek majątkowy w Polsce? Państwo musi wydawać [OPINIA]
grading_note: Author explicitly recommends future net-wealth taxation in addition to property taxes; no specific schedule.

design_detail: Advocates wealth taxation covering property and financial assets to reduce inequality; no own fixed rate
quote_original: Do tego z kolei służą różne formy podatku majątkowego.
quote_en: Various forms of wealth tax serve this purpose.
source_title: 10 najbogatszych osób w Polsce ma tyle, co 6,8 miliona najuboższych
grading_note: Read with the following paragraphs explicitly including company shares and bank deposits and recommending a higher tax to reduce wealth inequality. Grade A under the formal-act clause: adopted organisational policy or authored publication recommending a wealth tax.

design_detail: Coordinated international wealth taxes; discusses billionaire minimum and annual net-wealth designs
quote_original: Wiele problemów rozwiązałoby wprowadzenie globalnych standardów podatkowych na tym polu.
quote_en: Introducing global tax standards in this area would solve many problems.
source_title: Bogaci wyjadą, gospodarka upadnie? Nie tak działają podatki majątkowe
grading_note: Author advocates international wealth-tax coordination and wider adoption; does not merely report other people's positions. Date is the displayed publication date. Grade A under the formal-act clause: adopted organisational policy or authored publication recommending a wealth tax.
